title: Short-time behavior and invariant surfaces for caloric functions with non-constant boundary values
summary: We consider a Cauchy-Dirichlet problem for a heat equation with variable coefficients in non-divergence form. The initial values are assumed to be homogeneous, while the Dirichlet boundary values are non-constant. In this setting, we derive an asymptotic formula for the short-time behavior of the solution, which extends the celebrated Varadhan formula. We stress the fact that the boundary values are allowed to vanish or change sign.
